question: Will Apple release a foldable iPhone before 2027?
requirements: This market will resolve to "Yes" if Apple officially releases a foldable iPhone by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.
In order to be considered released, the product must be available for purchase by the general public within the specified timeframe.
context: Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".
An announcement or unveiling alone is not sufficient.
A qualifying release of a foldable smartphone by Apple will count even if it is not explicitly branded an iPhone.
The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from Apple.
However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
